params.caption: They are on the ninth verse. The high seat is empty.
Everyone is sitting down. One man is on his feet, going along the table with a horn.

plaques.text:
TARNHALL

Seven neighbourhoods came up the water every Long Light to feast here.

THE TARN CAUSEWAY

Seven boats. One was left ready to go, with the oars in.
Nobody came back down for any of them.

pickups.label: Pry up what the byre floor holds
Take the coat off its peg
Take the wool off the latch
Take the blade from the oar-stand

edges.doc: tools/audit_edges.py: the porch and the bridge are floors; the RIME ice is a floor over the tarn and the fjord head; the hall's front doors are a wall in RIME (barred).
